page.overview:
Who is Professor Sada?

Professor Sada is a character appearing in , who is also one of the Professors in the game, alongside Professor Turo in . She is a Professor who researches the lore of Paldea, and also the primary professor of Naranja Academy.

Professor Sada has a fierce and primal appearance that sets her apart from the typical image of a Pokémon professor. She wears a prehistoric-inspired outfit featuring an orange and black animal-print crop top and matching shorts with jagged edges, adorned with fang-like accessories at the waist. Her look is accessorized with fur-trimmed sandals and leg warmers, as well as a necklace and bracelets that resemble ancient tribal ornaments. Over this wild ensemble, she wears a stark white lab coat, blending her scientific role with her rugged aesthetic. Her long, voluminous brown hair is tied back with orange-striped bands, and she has sharp, confident eyes that reflect her bold and intense personality.

Sada had an immense fascination with history of the past and its Pokémon, so much so that she invented a time machine to make contact with the ancient past. She is a highly skilled inventor, with her time machine and robotic counterpart being prime examples. The robotic counterpart is far more advanced than any AI in the game, having retained her personality, memories and also has the ability to experience feelings and computing data.

Sada also had a strong desire to protect the time machine she created, taking great measures to keep it safe by installing numerous security systems to the point that her AI counterpart believed that it was all she cared about. However, the AI also remarks that she truly loved her son, another evidence of her love for Arven is the photo of Arven as a toddler and Mabosstiff as a Maschiff together that she has in her lab.
